heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 2152j to 2152j–4 of this title:

children.text: the Committee on Foreign Relations, the Committee on Armed Services, and the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and
the Committee on Foreign Affairs, the Committee on Armed Services, and the Committee on Appropriations of the of the 1 House of Representatives.

tree.heading: Relevant Federal departments and agencies
tree.text: The term “relevant Federal departments and agencies” means—

children.text: the United States Agency for International Development;
the Department of Homeland Security; and
any other department or agency specified by the President for purposes of sections 2152j to 2152j–4 of this title.

tree.heading: Stakeholders
tree.text: The term “stakeholders” means non-governmental and private sector entities engaged in or affected by conflict prevention and stabilization, peace building, protection, security, transition initiatives, humanitarian response, or related efforts.

notes.text: Codification Section was enacted as part of the Women, Peace, and Security Act of 2017, and not as part of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 which comprises this chapter.
